login.title: Welcome to Nithro
login.body: Log in with Discord to manage Nithro in your servers.
login.privacy: Nithro only reads your username, avatar and server list. It never sees your password or messages.
login.failed: Login didn't work. Please try again.

servers.title: Your servers
servers.subtitle: Servers where you're the owner or have Manage Server.
servers.empty: You don't manage any servers yet. You need Manage Server permission in a server to set up Nithro there.
servers.addedHint: Just added Nithro? It can take up to a minute to show up here.

guild.modulesSubtitle: Turn features on or off. Changes apply in Discord immediately.
guild.saveFailed: Couldn't save that change. It was undone.
guild.notInServerTitle: Nithro isn't in this server yet
guild.notInServerBody: Add Nithro to start configuring it.

moderation.name: Moderation
moderation.description: Warnings, timeouts, kicks and bans with a numbered case history, plus Discord AutoMod management.

guardian.name: Guardian
guardian.description: Stops hacked accounts, scam links and raids, and audits dangerous permissions.

logging.name: Logging
logging.description: Logs message edits and deletions, member changes and server changes to the channels you choose.

roles.name: Role panels
roles.description: Buttons and menus that let members pick their own roles.

welcome.name: Welcome
welcome.description: Greets new members and says goodbye, with optional automatic roles.

tickets.name: Tickets
tickets.description: Private support tickets with staff roles and transcripts.

status.comingSoon: Settings arrive in a later milestone

modSettings.title: Moderation settings
modSettings.subtitle: How moderation commands behave in this server.
modSettings.logChannelHelp: Every case is posted here. Nithro needs permission to send messages in it.
modSettings.dmUsersHelp: Send members a private message when they are warned, timed out, kicked or banned. Moderators can skip it per action with the silent option.
modSettings.requireReasonHelp: Moderators must give a reason for every action.
modSettings.moduleOff: The Moderation module is turned off. Settings are kept, but commands won't run until you turn it on in Modules.

cases.title: Cases
cases.subtitle: Every moderation action, newest first.
cases.deleteConfirm: Delete case #{{number}} from the history? It is kept in the audit trail and marked as deleted in the log channel.
cases.notFound: This case doesn't exist (or was deleted).

automod.title: AutoMod
automod.subtitle: Discord's built-in AutoMod, managed from here. Rules run on Discord's side, instantly, even if Nithro is offline.
automod.presetsSubtitle: Ready-made rules you can add with one click and adjust later.

invite_links.name: Block invite links
invite_links.description: Stops links to other Discord servers.

scam_phrases.name: Common scam phrases
scam_phrases.description: Blocks "free Nitro", fake giveaways and similar bait.

mention_spam.name: Mention spam
mention_spam.description: Blocks messages with 6+ mentions and times out the sender for 10 minutes.

form.name: Name
form.keywordsHelp: One per line. Use * as a wildcard, e.g. *scam* or free nitro*.
form.regexHelp: Optional. One per line, up to 10.
form.allowListHelp: One per line. Messages with these are never blocked.
form.exemptHelp: Members with these roles or messages in these channels are ignored.

errors.botUnavailable: The bot isn't responding right now. Make sure it's online and try again.
